shortDescription: Knowledge Economic City Company SJSC TADAWUL:4310:

children: KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY - SIGNS MOU WITH KADEN TO DEVELOP MULTAQA AL MADINAH 2 PROJECT
KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY - MOU TO ESTABLISH GENERAL FRAMEWORK FOR COOPERATION TO DEVELOP A MIXED-USE PROJECT NAMED “MULTAQA AL MADINAH 2”
KEC: EXPECTED TO RECEIVE CASH AMOUNT OF SAR 67.7 MILLION IN ADDITION TO UNITS IN THE TARGETED FUND EQUIVALENT TO SAR 624.6 MILLION
KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY -  PROJECT AIMS TO DEVELOP AN INTEGRATED EXTENSION TO THE EXISTING MULTAQA AL MADINAH PROJECT,
KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY -  PARTIES INTEND TO DEVELOP THE PROJECT THROUGH A CLOSED-ENDED REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT FUND
KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY -  KEC WILL CONTRIBUTE THE PROJECT LAND AS AN IN-KIND CONTRIBUTION
KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY -  KADEN WILL MAKE A CASH CONTRIBUTION
KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY -  KADEN WILL ALSO UNDERTAKE THE ROLE OF DEVELOPMENT MANAGER FOR THE PROJECT
KEC: UNDER PROPOSED INITIAL STRUCTURE, THE COMPANY WILL RETAIN FUND UNITS WITH AN ESTIMATED VALUE OF APPROXIMATELY SAR 624.6 MILLION
KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY -   PROJECT IS EXPECTED TO COMPRISE APPROXIMATELY 1,527 RESIDENTIAL UNITS DISTRIBUTED ACROSS THREE RESIDENTIAL ZONES
KEC: TOTAL PROJECT COST IS INITIALLY ESTIMATED AT APPROXIMATELY SAR 2.5 BILLION
KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY -    RESIDENTIAL COMPONENT IS INTENDED TO BE DEVELOPED FOR SALE, INCLUDING THE OFF-PLAN SALE OF UNITS
KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY - COMMERCIAL AND OFFICE COMPONENTS ARE INTENDED TO BE DEVELOPED, LEASED AND OPERATED
KNOWLEDGE ECONOMIC CITY -  PROJECT IS INTENDED TO BE FINANCED THROUGH A COMBINATION OF EQUITY, BANK FINANCING AND PROCEEDS FROM OFF-PLAN SALES
KEC: WILL HOLD 75% OF FUND UNITS IN CONSIDERATION FOR ITS IN-KIND CONTRIBUTION OF THE PROJECT LAND, WHILE KADEN INVESTMENT COMPANY WILL HOLD 25%
KEC: MOU PROVIDES 90-DAY EXCLUSIVITY PERIOD FOR FINALIZING DEFINITIVE AGREEMENTS
